title: Gallows' End Tavern
wikitext:
[[image:Gallows' End Tavern.jpg|thumb|Gallows' End Tavern]]
The '''Gallows' End Tavern''' features trainers for [[warrior]]s, [[priest]]s, [[mage]]s, [[rogue]]s, [[warlock]]s, [[enchanter]]s, and [[first aid]]. It also has an [[innkeeper]] and a few other vendors. This tavern is notable because it is the only fully functional tavern known to be run by the [[forsaken]].
